description: This file defines the CommitMessageGenerator class responsible for generating commit messages using AI, with methods for building prompts, calling AI services, and managing previous context.

classes.name: CommitMessageGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating commit messages via AI, managing context, and constructing prompts.

methods.name: generateMessage
methods.description: Generates a commit message based on provided parameters, manages progress updates, and handles errors.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt for AI based on git context, previous messages, and custom instructions.

methods.name: callAIForCommitMessage
methods.description: Calls the AI service to generate a commit message, handling configuration selection and progress updates.

methods.name: extractCommitMessage
methods.description: Cleans and extracts the commit message from the AI response.
